entries.title: Genesis 23:1
segments: And Sarah was a hundred twenty seven years old, the years of the life of Sarah.

entries.title: Genesis 23:2
segments: And Sarah died in Kirjath-arba; the same [is] Hebron in the land of Canaan. And Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.

entries.title: Genesis 23:3
segments: And Abraham stood up from before his dead, and spoke to the sons of Heth, saying,

entries.title: Genesis 23:4
segments: I am a stranger and a visitor with you. Give me a possession of a burying place with you, so that I may bury my dead out of my sight.

entries.title: Genesis 23:5
segments: And the sons of Heth answered Abraham saying to him,

entries.title: Genesis 23:6
segments: Hear us, my lord. You [are] a mighty prince among us. Bury your dead in the choice of our burying places. None of us shall withhold from you his burying-place from burying your dead.

entries.title: Genesis 23:7
segments: And Abraham stood up, and bowed himself to the people of the land, the sons of Heth.

entries.title: Genesis 23:8
segments: And he spoke with them, saying, If it is your mind that I should bury my dead out of my sight, hear me, and ask for me of Ephron the son of Zohar,

entries.title: Genesis 23:9
segments: that he may give me the cave of Machpelah which he has, which [is] in the end of his field. For as much silver as it is worth he shall give it to me for a possession of a burying-place among you.

entries.title: Genesis 23:10
segments: And Ephron lived among the sons of Heth. And Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the ears of the sons of Heth, of all that went in at the gate of his city, saying,

entries.title: Genesis 23:11
segments: No, my lord, hear me. I give you the field, and the cave that [is] in it I give to you. In the presence of the sons of my people I give it to you. Bury your dead.

entries.title: Genesis 23:12
segments: And Abraham bowed before the people of the land.

entries.title: Genesis 23:13
segments: And he spoke to Ephron in the ears of the people of the land, saying, Only if you would hear me. I will give you silver for the field. Take [it] from me, and I will bury my dead there.

entries.title: Genesis 23:14
segments: And Ephron answered Abraham, saying to him,

entries.title: Genesis 23:15
segments: My lord, listen to me. The land [is worth] four hundred shekels of silver; what is that between me and you? And bury your dead.

entries.title: Genesis 23:16
segments: And Abraham listened to Ephron. And Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver which he had named in the hearing of the sons of Heth, four hundred shekels of silver, which passes with the merchant.

entries.title: Genesis 23:17
segments: And the field of Ephron was certified, which was Machpelah, which [was] before Mamre; the field and the cave which [was] in it, and all the trees in the field, in all the borders round about,

entries.title: Genesis 23:18
segments: to Abraham for a possession in the presence of the sons of Heth, before all that went in at the gate of his city.

entries.title: Genesis 23:19
segments: And after this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave at the field of Machpelah before Mamre, which [is] Hebron, in the land of Canaan.

entries.title: Genesis 23:20
segments: And the field, and the cave that [is] in it, were certified to Abraham for a possession of a burying place by the sons of Heth.
